system.text:
The Zealot is a fervent believer. He has taken hold of a doctrine and made it his own. The Zealot trait allows the player to add an additional (fourth) Belief to his character. The Belief must relate to the doctrine of his cult or sect. If you have a fourth Belief from another trait, replace your first Belief with your zealotry.

Type: Dt (die trait). Unpriced: costs 1 pt as a lifepath trait.

Restrictions: Human lifepath trait —JRR Tolkien, The Silmarillion

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 355
